steps: Heat the oil in a deep pan on medium heat and add the bay leaf for a few seconds.
Add the onion and green chilli and fry for 7 to 8 minutes, stirring, until deep golden.
Add the ginger and garlic and stir for about a minute, until the raw smell goes.
Add the tomato, turmeric and salt and cook, stirring, until the tomato is soft and mushy.
Turn the heat to low, stir in the curd, chilli powder, coriander powder and garam masala, and cook until it smells fragrant.
Add the chicken and fry on medium heat for about 3 minutes, until pale on all sides, then cover on low for 3 to 4 minutes.
Pour in about 60 ml hot water a person, cover and cook on medium for about 15 minutes, until the chicken is soft and the gravy thick.
Turn off the heat, stir in the crushed kasuri methi and scatter over the coriander leaves.
note: Chicken is bone-in weight: the sources give 167 to 250 g a person, and 200 g is a normal adult share. One source writes onion as both 1 cup and 3 medium; about 55 g a person matches the other two.
